theorems.rational_countermodel: For each fixed nonempty finite shift set H, there is a sequence 0<=a_n<=n with dyadic sum 8/255 and simultaneous modulo-four prime pulses at infinitely many p=3 mod 4.
theorems.two_scale_feasibility: Positive 2^K-divisible totient endpoint at N+L and L<=K forces the standard infinite-difference error upper bound (N+H+L+2)/2^L>1.

boundaries: No certification or Lean checking of these new manuscript theorems
